intro: The Tycoon Ultra sofa is a masterclass in comfort and convenience. Its sleek design, solid wood frame, & plush foam cushions create a seating experience that’s as functional and durable as it is indulgent.

features.title: A backrest that supports where it matters
features.text: The thoughtfully designed mid-backrest provides gentle support to your shoulders and spine, so you can sit comfortably without strain, whether for work or relaxation.

features.title: Spacious armrests, effortless comfort
features.text: With wide, cushioned armrests and elegant tufted detailing, this sofa offers generous arm and shoulder support along with lasting comfort and style.

features.title: Soft foam for plush comfort
features.text: Equipped with soft foam cushioning, this sofa provides excellent support for long hours of lounging, reading, or simply relaxing.

features.title: Easy-to-clean synthetic leather upholstery
features.text: The Tycoon Ultra sofa features synthetic leather upholstery that's incredibly easy to clean, making it perfect for busy households or anyone who values style without the stress.

features.title: Built to last for years
features.text: Made with a solid wood frame, this sofa is durable enough to handle daily use and still look great, perfect for active households or anyone who loves lasting quality.

features.title: A raised design for a fresh, open look
features.text: With elevated legs, the Tycoon not only looks light and airy but also makes cleaning underneath effortless, keeping your home neat and tidy.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
